Uniaxial displacement-controlled coupon; its synthetic time axis is not hull pressure.

detail.reason: Native Cauchy stress components near 300 MPa are printed in 0.0001 MPa increments; a 1e-5 equivalent-stress equality check is below output quantization.
detail.resource_choice: Four cores retained: the eight-core trial was only 16.7 percent faster while reserving twice as many cores.

points.trial_interpolation: native target increment, printed-time rounding <0.0001 kPa
native target increment, printed-time rounding <0.0001 kPa

detail.scope: Identical pre-yield law and geometry at a=1 mm. Both load histories reach service and 1.05 service at native increments. Actual-yield boundary confirmations remain separate.

detail.method: Every final pass/fail edge uses a native target-pressure increment. Where adaptive cutbacks skipped service, an additional linear-ramp service cap replaces interpolation.

detail.note: Independent pressure-force balance; finite geometry and thickness redistribute face stress.
